2239-4875-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2239-4875-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Conspiracy, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4863-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4863-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

206-3490-7075-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
206-3490-7075-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-4050-4153--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

1870-4324-4873-5087.easyPrerequisites: Darksteel Reactor and Eternity Vessel have at least twenty charge counters combined.
1870-4324-4873-5087.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield at instant speed.
There is at least one counter of any kind on The Ozolith.
1870-4324-4873-5087.description:
At the beginning of combat, Workshop Elders and The Ozolith trigger.
Resolve the Workshop Elders trigger, making Eternity Vessel a creature.
In response to the remaining trigger, cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
Resolve The Ozolith trigger from step 1, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4089-4890.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4089-4890.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Glasspool Mimic and Dack's Duplicate each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4089-4890.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

489-1895-2781-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

129-1409-4289-4927.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

3249-3967-5111-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

1368-2033-4885-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2033-4885-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3317-5972-6797.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3317-5972-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Historian's Boon triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2034-3129-4017-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-3129-4017-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

3110-3532-3761-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3110-3532-3761-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

3174-3967-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

821-2173-4699-5220.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3362-4264.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Altered Ego
3362-4264.description:
Cast Altered Ego by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Altered Ego's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

772-5256-6553.easyPrerequisites: Shade's Form attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
772-5256-6553.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2060-2511-3693-5544-6431.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
2060-2511-3693-5544-6431.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Walking Ballista ability from step 3.
Repeat.

2281-2921-3305.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Body Launderer.
When Saffi dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1636-2857-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
1636-2857-4050.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2097-4770-5554.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure token.
2097-4770-5554.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure token you control.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1750-2793-2921-5261-5740.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Assassin that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1750-2793-2921-5261-5740.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using an Assassin, triggering Layla Hassan, returning Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1322-3259-3973-4050.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four permanents of any color on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature you control except Rith.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-3973-4050.description:
Deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Rith trigger, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least four 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Saproling token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Saprolings, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1284-2178-4221.notablePrerequisites: Viridian Longbow and Thornbite Staff attached to the same creature you control without summoning sickness.
1284-2178-4221.description:
Whenever a land enters the battlefield, it enters as a 1/1 creature due to Living Plane.
Activate the creature with Viridian Longbow and Thornbite Staff attached by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the land.
The land dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The creature triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat as desired for each land an opponent controls, and whenever a land enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2390-3372-3681.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a counter on a permanent or player.
2390-3372-3681.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing All Will Be One to become an enchantment creature until end of turn.
Activate Grafted Exoskeleton's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to All Will Be One.
Put a counter on a permanent or player.
All Will Be One triggers, giving an opponent a poison counter and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat step 4.

1283-1978-2734.description:
Animate Chromatic Orrery using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 2.

1030-2034-3464.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-2034-3464.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hyrax Tower Scout, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.
